name: TC-1962: uploading a PNG replaces the picture; the old file is deleted from storage
description: POST /api/deals/:id/image (multipart `file`, PNG) → 200 { imageUrl, imageStatus: completed } and the Promotions list row's picture.url is that URL. A second upload changes picture.url, and the FIRST url answers 404 or 403 within 10 s (the old file is removed after the new one is saved).
